API Documentation

Dutchkem Voice Agent v3.0.0 — REST API Reference

Authentication

POST /api/auth/register Register a new user
POST /api/auth/login Authenticate user & get JWT
GET /api/auth/me Get current user profile

Modes

GET /api/modes/ List all available modes 9 modes
GET /api/modes/{mode_id} Get mode details
POST /api/modes/switch Switch active mode

Interview & Proctoring

POST /api/proctoring/start Start interview session
POST /api/proctoring/stop Stop interview session
GET /api/proctoring/report/{session_id} Get session report

Voice

POST /api/voice/tts Text-to-speech synthesis
POST /api/voice/stt Speech-to-text transcription

Coaching

GET /api/coaching/tips Get coaching tips for active mode
POST /api/coaching/feedback Submit response for coaching

System

GET /health Health check endpoint
GET /docs Swagger UI (debug mode)
Note: Interactive API docs with Swagger UI are available at /docs when DEBUG=true. The colourful admin dashboard is at /admin.
